features.name: Carousing step at adventure end
features.notes: Multi-phase AdventureCompleteScreen: victory → carousing → rolling → result → [leveling-hp → leveling-talent → leveling-spells] → done. 7 tiers (30–1800gp), d8+bonus roll, 14 outcomes. features.name: API key encryption at rest (AES-256-GCM)
features.notes: BTORCH-47. AES-256-GCM via Web Crypto API in src/lib/crypto.ts. Encrypted format enc:v1:{iv}:{ciphertext}. All write paths encrypt, all read paths decrypt. Legacy plaintext handled gracefully. One-time admin migration route + button. getEncryptionSecret() falls back to process.env for local dev.
